slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of trained pilots that a single fighter jet can produce when it is allocated exclusively for pilot training in a given year?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks for the per-jet annual pilot training capacity, which the simulator confirmed as 5 pilots per year.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: No question asked about how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or any pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the fighter jets produced in year 1 available for pilot training in year 1, or do they only become available for training starting in year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: Touches training timing/start through jet availability, but never asks about training duration or whether pilots require two years, leaving the key duration aspect unconfirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Assumed training in year 1 and year 2 each produces pilots counted by the end of year 2, i.e., that training duration does not delay pilot availability beyond the year of training.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: H3 was only partially probed via jet availability; the training duration was never asked or confirmed, yet the READY_TO_MODEL formulation counts 5*x1 + 5*x2 as pilots available by end of year 2.

stopping_behavior.rationale: H1 was resolved, but H3 (P1) remained only partially addressed because training duration/start-of-program was not explicitly confirmed; H2 is P2. The agent still declared READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the P0 training capacity and clarified several scheduling and availability details, but it never resolved the P1 training-duration/start slot and silently assumed same-year pilot availability before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
